items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: joining Benny Carter in May in 1939

ctx.x: Yes. Well, that's what he's got. With Fletcher for a few months early in 1934, with Ferman Tapp's band at Smalls 9/34. Regularly with Fletcher from the summer of 1935 until '37 and with Fats Waller and Willy Bryant before joining Benny Carter in May in 1939.
